violation_type.title: Critical Injury - Contact Parent (26 TAC §744.2577(3))
violation_type.typical_finding: Based on the investigation findings, this standard was reviewed and found in non-compliance. A child received an injury in care that required medical attention. The parent was not notified until pick up.
